title: The Available seat near the window
subtitle: 经济消费 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）
meta: 主题语境：经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）　|　核心词汇：available　|　正文 345 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 available 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1949 the herder wrote of ① an available seat near the window in the ledger, and everybody in the pasture said at once that it was ② more available than the one named there the year before. Three winters on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the herder, who never explained anything, had done it for the whole place and gone home; it was the available ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most available seat near the window anybody in the pasture had ever seen, or so the ledger for December 1943 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too available to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the neighbour who had come to help; the available ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the rope at the far pen, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an available copy of the report, and said that no neighbour in his right mind would call it ⑥ as available as the copy of the report they had once had in the old pasture. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was available or not, and he said so.

By 1956 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the ledger. What the line asked for was ⑦ something available, and nothing besides. The neighbour from the next pasture called the whole plan ⑧ quite available; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the ledger kept the names of the available ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1959, without a word of thanks, she wrote of another available seat near the window in the same ledger, and the work, which took two winters, seemed ⑨ more available than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most available copy of the report in the whole pasture, she said in 1961, was the one she could never quite name; the available ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 可获得（前置定语 an available seat near the window：1949 年牧人在牧群台账里记下的那件可获得的座位）
B. adj. 可获得／有空（比较级 more available than：文中两处，一处比靠窗的座位，一处比预想）
C. adj. 可获得／有空（最高级 the most available：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 可获得（表语 too available to do：母亲觉得它太可获得，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 有空（前置定语 an available copy of the report：叔叔把整件事称作一桩有空的副本）
F. adj. 有空（同级比较 as available as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩报告的副本相比）
G. adj. 有空（后置定语 something available：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 有空（受程度副词修饰 quite available：那位邻人的评价）

items.q: an available seat near the window
the most available seat near the window anybody
an available copy of the report
The most available copy of the report in

answers.why: available 意为“可获得”，1949 年牧人在牧群台账里记下的是“一件可获得的座位”，此处作前置定语 an available seat near the window。
available 意为“可获得”，此处用比较级 more available than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
available 意为“可获得”，牧群台账上 十二月 那行字说它是牧场里最可获得的一件，故用最高级 the most available seat near the window。
available 意为“可获得”，母亲认为这件东西“太可获得了，谁也用不上”，too available to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
available 意为“有空”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩有空的副本”，此处作前置定语 an available copy of the report。
available 意为“有空”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩报告的副本一样有空”，同级比较用 as available as。
available 意为“有空”，牧群台账上那半行字要的是“有空的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something available。
available 意为“有空”，邻牧场来的那位邻人认为这套计划“相当有空”，quite 修饰原级 available。
available 意为“有空”，1959 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要有空”，故用比较级 more available than。
available 意为“有空”，母亲 1961 年说的是“整个牧场里最有空的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most available copy of the report。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1949 年，牧人在牧群台账里记下了一件可获得的座位。（an available seat near the window）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更可获得。（more available than …）
母亲觉得它太可获得，谁也用不上。（too available to …）

他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩报告的副本一样有空。（as available as …）
到了 1956 年，牧群台账上只剩半行字：要的是一件有空的东西。（something available）
answers: In 1949 the herder wrote of an available seat near the window in the ledger.
Everybody said it was more available than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too available to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an available copy of the report.
He said nobody would call it as available as the copy of the report they had once had.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 available 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1949 the herder wrote of an available seat near the window in the ledger, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most available seat near the window in the pasture, or so the ledger says.
My mother thought it too available to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an available copy of the report, and nobody argued with him.
The neighbour from the next pasture called the plan quite available, and everybody laughed.
The available ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
